caption: Urgent-first planning wastes momentum. This carousel shows five prompts to shift to impact-first prioritization. Use them on your next backlog to finish more meaningful work. Which backlog item would gain the most from impact-first planning this week? #AIforWork #Productivity #Prioritization #Workflows

slides.title: Impact-First Planning Over Urgency
slides.body: Urgent tasks derail your plan. Five prompts to diagnose, prioritize by impact, plan, execute, and refine.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose bottlenecks
slides.body: Prompt: Analyze backlog [BACKLOG_SUMMARY]. Output top 3 bottlenecks with impact 1-5 and one-sentence justification.

slides.title: 2. Reprioritize by impact
slides.body: Prompt: Score each item in [BACKLOG] by impact and effort. Output a ranked list with brief rationale.

slides.title: 3. Plan milestones
slides.body: Prompt: For top 5 items, draft a 2-week plan with milestones and owners.

slides.title: 4. Schedule execution
slides.body: Prompt: Convert plan into a sprint schedule with daily tasks and dependencies.

slides.title: 5. Check and refine
slides.body: Prompt: After one week, evaluate results, update backlog, and re-prioritize.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Adopt impact-first planning to finish more work with less waste. Save this guide for your next backlog.
